test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

Rashmi said to Reshma, "Mahima was dancing on the floor when she was called by her mother."

options.text: Rashmi told Reshma that Mahima had danced on the floor when she had been called by her mother.
Rashmi told Reshma that Mahima had been danching on the floor when was called by her mother.
Rashmi told Reshma that Mahima had been dancing on the floor when she had been called by her mother.
Rashmi told Reshma that Mahima was dancing on the floor when she was called by her mother.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct Speech:** Rashmi said to Reshma, "Mahima was dancing on the floor when she was called by her mother."
 
• **Reporting verb:** The reporting verb "said" is in the past tense, so the tense in the reported clause must be backshifted (sequence of tenses).
 
• **Key Conversions:** 
 
 
• The past continuous "was dancing" → past perfect continuous "had been dancing".
 
• The past simple passive "was called" → past perfect passive "had been called".
 
• Quotation marks are removed and the clause is introduced by "that".
 
 
 
• **Result:** The most accurate reported form preserves aspect and voice by converting to past perfect continuous and past perfect passive respectively: *had been dancing* / *had been called*.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Rashmi told Reshma that Mahima had been dancing on the floor when she had been called by her mother.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Rashmi told Reshma that Mahima had danced on the floor when she had been called by her mother. 

 
 
• This changes the continuous action to simple past perfect ("had danced"), which loses the progressive aspect of the original ("was dancing").
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** Rashmi told Reshma that Mahima had been danching on the floor when was called by her mother. 
 
 
• Contains a spelling error ("danching") and a grammatical omission ("when was called" lacks the subject); also tense/structure is incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** Rashmi told Reshma that Mahima was dancing on the floor when she was called by her mother. 
 
 
• This option fails to backshift the tenses after a past reporting verb and therefore is incorrect in reported speech.
